We need to understand Persian couplets. Each option has two lines separated by ')'. Need to find which option has different concept/message from others.

Let's translate roughly.

Option1:
"دهد کوهکن را ز هجران به یاد - ) به خسرو ز شیرین ببخشد مراد"
First line: "He gives the mountain‑breaker (maybe a lover) from separation to remembrance"? Hard.
Second line: "to Khosrow from sweet he grants desire". Might be about love, longing, granting wishes.

Option2:
"یکی را سزاوار تخت آفرید - ) یکی را چنین تیره بخت آفرید"
First: "He created one worthy of the throne"
Second: "He created another so dark fate". So contrast of destiny, fate.

Option3:
"از آهن یکى کنده بر پای اوست - ) کسی را که بر تخت زر جای

Wait: "از آهن یکی کنده بر پای اوست" maybe "One made of iron is a cripple on his foot"? Not sure. "کسی را که بر تخت زر جای اوست" "someone who is placed on a golden throne". So maybe about material vs status.

Option4:
"سری را برآرد به چرخ بلند - ) سری را کند بر زمین

First: "He lifts a head to the high heavens"
Second: "He puts a head on the earth". So about elevation vs downfall.

We need which option differs conceptually. Options 2,3,4 seem about contrast of high vs low, fate, status. Option1 maybe about love and longing, not about contrast of status. So likely option1 is outlier.

Thus answer: 1.
